returned_tweets.author: ns123abc
returned_tweets.text: BREAKING: TRUMP ON ANTHROPIC. REPORTER: Do you view Anthropic and to a degree its CEO, Dario Amodei, as a threat to national security? TRUMP: "Well, not now, but a week ago, maybe. I was with him yesterday, he made a speech... seemed like a nice guy, smart guy. But he responded to us very quickly, because you know it's a tremendous liability... he responded very responsibly, I thought." REPORTER: Would you consider using the Defense Production Act to possibly regulate or control AI? TRUMP: "I would, but, I'm not sure I have to do that. I think so far it's been very responsible. Actually, it was a competitor, and a part-owner, that turned Anthropic in..."

returned_tweets.author: synthwavedd
returned_tweets.text: SCOOP: After the release of Fable 5 and with GPT-5.6 looming, the mood behind the scenes at Google DeepMind is increasingly one of frustration and broad discontent over the lab's perceived fall into a distant third-or even fourth-place. DeepMind's best model now sits in fifth place on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index. Gemini 3.5 Pro, slated to launch June 30th, is described internally as not the step change needed to be competitive. Employees: We no longer have a frontier model in text, image, video, voice, or even vision.

returned_tweets.author: AndrewYNg
returned_tweets.text: Over the last two weeks, both the U.S. Government and Anthropic took significant actions that demonstrated their power to control access to AI by restricting what others can do with frontier models. Anthropic restricted developers' ability to use Fable 5 to build competing LLM technology and initially silently degraded performance for users detected doing LLM research. The U.S. Government then restricted exports of Mythos and Fable, requiring a license for any foreign national, leading Anthropic to disable Fable worldwide. Many nations now see how access can be yanked, spurring AI-sovereignty and open-source efforts.

returned_tweets.author: ClaudeDevs
returned_tweets.text: Update: we've gone ahead and reset 5-hour and weekly usage limits for everyone, across all plans. Enjoy your weekend!

returned_tweets.author: Variety
returned_tweets.text: Luca Guadagnino's nearly finished Sam Altman movie, "Artificial," has been dropped by Amazon MGM Studios. The film, starring Andrew Garfield as the controversial OpenAI CEO, will be shopped to other studios. The move notably comes after Amazon struck a massive partnership with OpenAI.

returned_tweets.author: ValsAI
returned_tweets.text: GLM 5.2 is the only open-weight model to break 60% on Vibe Code Bench v1.1, our test of whether models can build web applications from scratch. It scores 64%, and no other open-weight model on the board reaches even 50%. That puts it 14 percentage points ahead of the next open-weight model.

returned_tweets.author: sahilypatel
returned_tweets.text: anthropic is assembling the most cracked team in tech. in the past 18 months, they've hired: peter bailis (workday cto), bryan mccann (you com cto), mike krieger (instagram co-founder), sam ghods (box cto), henry shi (super cto), niki parmar (adept ai cto), karpathy (openai founding member), and now john jumper (nobel laureate).

returned_tweets.author: N01ennn
returned_tweets.text: A 21-year-old from China runs 300 AI agents at once. He shows the swarm live, 300 Kimi K2.6 agents firing in parallel, then Opus 4.8 checking every single output against its source. He pointed it at 100 EV-market companies. First pass: 12 failed (wrong revenue, dead citations, empty fields). Second pass: 3 failed. Third pass: zero. It is a system that catches its own mistakes before he reads a single row.

returned_tweets.author: DataChaz
returned_tweets.text: A Netflix engineer just open-sourced Headroom, one of the smartest ways to cut LLM costs. It wraps Cursor or Claude in a local proxy to compress your payload before it hits the LLM: intelligently shrinks logs, JSON, and code, preserves logic accuracy, keeps 100% of your data local, and stops Opus-tier models wasting tokens on boilerplate. Up to 95% token reduction with zero code changes. It already crossed 35K stars.

returned_tweets.author: GaryMarcus
returned_tweets.text: The only quarter in which a major LLM company came close to being profitable was at the peak of this chart (and also depended on a substantial one-time subsidy from Elon). Prices going down is good for consumers, but makes it even harder for hyperscalers to make profits.

returned_tweets.author: noisyb0y1
returned_tweets.text: A developer ran a trillion-parameter model on 4 Mac Studios, 10x faster and 5x cheaper than cloud. RDMA over Thunderbolt made the cluster 10x faster; tensor parallelism splits the model between machines in parallel. DeepSeek V3 full size without quantization, 183GB per machine, 25 tokens per second. Kimi K2 with trillion parameters and 256,000 context window loaded and responded. Four machines consuming 66 watts total; the equivalent cloud GPU workload costs $1,900/month.

returned_tweets.author: carolecadwalla
returned_tweets.text: You see what is happening here? Amazon Studios drops film about OpenAI's Sam Altman after Amazon has done a $50bil deal with OpenAI. 'It is believed the film is not a flattering portrait of the tech mogul.'

returned_tweets.author: DiscussingFish
returned_tweets.text: Luca Guadagnino's 'ARTIFICIAL', a biopic about OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, reportedly ends with on-screen text that blames Altman and his associates for The War in Iran and the kidnapping of Nicolas Maduro. The movie was dumped by Amazon earlier today.
